title: Marshall Cottage Reservations | Rosemary Beach Home Rentals | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Reserve Our Marshall Cottage. This 4-bed, 3.5-bath cottage stretches 2,381 square feet and can sleep 10 guests. Our beach cottage is perfect for large groups for your next vacation.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Sunset Beach, and pool access at the large Lagoon Pool. Beach service chairs can be rented through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

This 4-bed, 3.5-bath cottage stretches an impressive 2,381 square feet, allowing it to sleep a total of 10 guests. This makes it perfect for those looking to travel with a larger group. As you walk up to your new home, you will spot the front porch with two adirondack chairs. Entering the home, you’ll notice the expert use of colors and décor which give the place a relaxed mood that perfectly matches the coastal area. You’ll find the comfortable living area, as well as a dining area with a traditional farmhouse table. The kitchen is complete with granite countertops and stainless appliances.

As you walk up to the second floor, you will find two of your bedrooms. The master bedroom has a king bed, as well as a cozy reading area should you so desire it. You’ll also find a deep garden tub in the private bathroom as well as a private balcony in which to enjoy the golden colors of a coastal sunset. You’ll also find the guest bedroom fitted with a king bed as well as a walk-in closet and en suite bathroom.

If you climb the stairs once more, you’ll find yourself on the third floor which houses a rather unique outdoor living area and even a summer kitchen! In addition, the second guest room with a twin and full bed, flat screen television, and access to the balcony, is on this floor. You’ll also find the third and final guest room which comes with a queen bed and television.

**THIS PROPERTY NOT LOCATED IN ROSEMARY BEACH. NO ACCESS TO ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY POOLS OR BEACH WALKOVERS.**

THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY YEAR ROUND
